tr_h_list: When a user submits valid credentials, the system shall authenticate the user.
When a user submits invalid credentials, the system shall not authenticate the user.
When a user submits credentials with an expired password, the system shall prompt for a password update.
When an MFA verification code is submitted, the system shall complete the authentication process.
When an invalid MFA verification code is submitted, the system shall not complete the authentication process.
When a user requests session termination, the system shall terminate the current session.
When a security policy is violated, the system shall terminate the current session.
When an access token is near expiration, the system shall refresh the access token.
When an access token has expired, the system shall not use it for authentication.
When a user is successfully authenticated, the system shall issue a new access token.
When an access token is refreshed, the system shall issue a new access token.
When an invalid access token is used for authentication, the system shall not authenticate the user.
When an expired access token is used for authentication, the system shall not authenticate the user.
When a user attempts to log in, the system shall authenticate using multi-factor authentication within 2 seconds.
When multi-factor authentication is enabled, the system shall request a valid MFA code.
When an invalid or expired MFA code is entered, the system shall display an error message.
When multi-factor authentication is enabled, the system shall allow access within 5 minutes of a valid MFA code being entered.
When an invalid or expired MFA code is entered, the system shall not allow access.
When multi-factor authentication is enabled, the system shall request a new MFA code after 3 failed login attempts.
When an invalid or expired MFA code is entered, the system shall not request a new MFA code.
When multi-factor authentication is enabled, the system shall allow a maximum of 5 login attempts within 1 hour.
When an invalid or expired MFA code is entered, the system shall log the event.
When multi-factor authentication is enabled, the system shall display instructions for obtaining a valid MFA code.
When an invalid or expired MFA code is entered, the system shall not display instructions for obtaining a valid MFA code.
When user submits valid credentials, the system shall authenticate successfully.
When user requests access token refresh, the system shall issue a new access token.
When user terminates the session, the system shall invalidate the access token.
When authentication service receives a valid authentication request, the system shall issue an access token.
When user submits a valid MFA verification code, the system shall authenticate successfully.
When user submits an invalid or expired MFA code, the system shall return an error response.
When user submits an invalid or expired MFA code, the system shall not authenticate the user.
When user submits a valid authentication request, the system shall authenticate successfully within 2 seconds.
When user requests access token refresh, the system shall issue a new access token within 1 second.
When user terminates the session, the system shall invalidate the access token within 1 second.
When authentication service receives a valid authentication request, the system shall issue an access token within 2 seconds.
When user submits a valid MFA verification code, the system shall authenticate successfully within 2 seconds.
